summary: All T12 acceptance criteria verified: moves atomically emit source-deleted/target-created in one transaction, every DAV-relevant mutation path has regression coverage, imported writes are rejected, and no duplicate changes occur. Full backend test suite passes with zero failures.
important_context: Recurring/occurrence mutation paths (create_recurring, update_occurrence, delete_occurrence, update_all_day_occurrence, delete_all_day_occurrence) intentionally do not record DAV changes because the DAV layer only exposes non-recurring timed events (list_exposed_event_ids filters recurrence_rule IS NULL). Recurrence DAV sync is T14 scope.
